_comment: Probes that cannot be derived mechanically. `object` probes are generated from the migration text; these are not, and each says why in `looked_for`. Keep this file when regenerating. Data probes are guarded with to_regclass: on a database that never ran the migration, the table is absent and an unguarded probe aborts the entire checker. 0126's probe deliberately reads a row written AFTER the statement the broken version aborted on. The original probe read a function created BEFORE it, so a file that stopped half way reported PRESENT. That is the exact lie this file exists to stop.

0047.looked_for: grant: SELECT on v_boq_billing_position to ordence_app
0047.expr: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='v_boq_billing_position' AND grantee='ordence_app' AND privilege_type='SELECT')

0168.looked_for: the COMMENT on view security_event_stream no longer says platform-scope raises are unrecorded , 0168 only rewrites a comment, so the comment text IS the artefact
0168.expr: (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_views WHERE schemaname='public' AND viewname='security_event_stream') AND coalesce(obj_description((SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='security_event_stream'),'pg_class'),'') NOT LIKE '%not recorded anywhere%')
